evidence.detail: prepare_people always sets p.url = f'/people/{username}/' regardless of season context
season_id is available in people_api() but not passed to prepare_people, so all-time people page (/seasons/all/people/) links resolve to current-season person pages

triage.fix_sketch: In decksite/prepare.py, add a season_id parameter to prepare_people. When season_id == 0 (all), set p.url = f'/seasons/all/people/{username}/' instead of the bare /people/ path. In decksite/controllers/api.py:276, pass season_id to prepare_people(people, season_id). ~10 lines changed.
triage.notes: The fix must also handle the case where season_id is a specific past season number (could generate /seasons/{n}/people/{username}/); only the 'all' case is reported in this issue but the same logic applies.
